hebrews.3.p1.b1.text: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.

hebrews.3.p1.b2.text: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.

hebrews.3.p1.b3.text: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

hebrews.3.p2.b4.text: Now Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house, testifying to what would be spoken later.

hebrews.3.p2.b5.text: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house.

hebrews.3.p2.b6.text: And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.

hebrews.3.p3.b7.text: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says:

hebrews.3.p3.b8.text: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness, …

hebrews.3.p3.b9.text: where your fathers tested and tried Me, and for forty years saw My works.

hebrews.3.p3.b10.text: Therefore I was angry with that generation, … So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’”

hebrews.3.p4.b11.text: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.

hebrews.3.p4.b12.text: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.

hebrews.3.p4.b13.text: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.

hebrews.3.p4.b14.text: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”

hebrews.3.p5.b15.text: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled?

hebrews.3.p5.b16.text: Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?

hebrews.3.p5.b17.text: And with whom was God angry for forty years? … And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?

hebrews.3.p5.b18.text: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
